description: A knob whose two end points are themselves knobs, giving any voltage between them

params.text: Picks a point between the CCW and CW voltages, 0 to 100%
Attenuates and inverts the CV that modulates the level, -100% to 100%, with no effect at the centre position
Sets the voltage the LEVEL knob gives when it is fully counter-clockwise, within the range chosen by its UNI/BI switch
Attenuates and inverts the CV that modulates the counter-clockwise limit, -100% to 100%, with no effect at the centre position
Sets the range of the CCW knob: 0-10V at UNI, or -5 to 5V at BI
Sets the voltage the LEVEL knob gives when it is fully clockwise, within the range chosen by its UNI/BI switch
Attenuates and inverts the CV that modulates the clockwise limit, -100% to 100%, with no effect at the centre position
Sets the range of the CW knob: 0-10V at UNI, or -5 to 5V at BI

inputs.text: Modulates the level; every 1V here turns the LEVEL knob a tenth of its travel clockwise, after the attenuverter
Modulates the counter-clockwise limit; every 1V here turns the CCW knob a tenth of its travel clockwise, after the attenuverter
Modulates the clockwise limit; every 1V here turns the CW knob a tenth of its travel clockwise, after the attenuverter

outputs.text: Carries the voltage the LEVEL knob picks between the CCW and CW voltages

notes: control voltage can drive any of these knobs past its normal limit, so the output can leave the range the CCW and CW knobs describe
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel
